# Start here: set your local paths, save, then Knit

Only `INPUT_FILE` needs changing when the workbook is not beside this Rmd.
Use the **same `OUTPUT_ROOT` in every module**. The Rmd itself may be stored anywhere.
No `.Rproj`, helper `.R` file, configuration file or previous analysis is required.
Module 14 only reads other modules' completed outputs for its optional review.

```{r user-settings, include=FALSE}
# A workbook beside this Rmd works with this default. Otherwise enter its full path.
# Windows example: INPUT_FILE <- "C:/my-study/ALL_DATA_clean_for_analysis.xlsx"
INPUT_FILE <- "ALL_DATA_clean_for_analysis.xlsx"

# Automatic results folders are created here; keep this outside the public GitHub folder.
OUTPUT_ROOT <- if (.Platform$OS.type=="windows") "C:/MAMI_results_simple" else "~/MAMI_results_simple"
AUTO_INSTALL_PACKAGES <- TRUE  # Install missing R packages from CRAN; internet required.
```

# Objective and verified timing

This file is standalone and reads the unchanged source workbook directly. Maternal diet refers to the **third trimester of pregnancy**; maternal and infant faecal microbiota refer to **one month postpartum**. Statistical input is never sourced from another module. Module 14 optionally reviews completed current-version outputs only.

Tables, figures and logs are saved automatically under `<OUTPUT_ROOT>/08_paired_maternal_infant_microbiota/`. `0.01` is interpreted on the 0–1 relative-abundance scale (**1%**), not 0.01%. Do not compare new q-values with old filtered screens as though the hypothesis families were unchanged.

# Self-contained setup and audited analysis helpers

```{r embedded-setup, include=FALSE}
MODULE_NAME <- "08_paired_maternal_infant_microbiota"
# EMBEDDED IN EVERY Rmd: no source() or dependence on another module's results.
PIPELINE_VERSION <- "MAMI_simple_standalone_1.1.0"
options(stringsAsFactors=FALSE, scipen=999)
set.seed(20261027)
# 0.01 is a PROPORTION: 1%, not 0.01%. The rule is applied BEFORE zero replacement.
MIN_RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE <- 0.01
MIN_SAMPLE_PREVALENCE <- 0.50
CLR_ZERO_REPLACEMENTS <- c(1e-6, 1e-7, 1e-5)
PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT <- 1e-6
MICRO_MIN_N <- 6L
PERMANOVA_MIN_N <- 8L
N_PERMUTATIONS <- 1999L
BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES <- 999L
PLOT_DPI <- 600L
DIET_REFERENCE_PERIOD <- "Maternal third trimester of gestation (user-confirmed)"
MICROBIOTA_TIMEPOINT <- "Maternal and infant faecal microbiota: one month postpartum"
# Arsenic month labels remain as supplied: both milk and urine contain 1m and 2m.
# Neither urinary ratios nor 16S taxa measure microbial methylation activity.
# Direct local paths. No project root, configuration file or companion script.
ACTIVE_RMD <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE), error=function(e) "")
if (!length(ACTIVE_RMD) || !nzchar(ACTIVE_RMD[1])) {
  ACTIVE_RMD <- if (requireNamespace("rstudioapi", quietly=TRUE))
    tryCatch(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path, error=function(e) "") else ""
}
ACTIVE_DIR <- if (length(ACTIVE_RMD)==1L && nzchar(ACTIVE_RMD) && file.exists(ACTIVE_RMD))
  dirname(normalizePath(ACTIVE_RMD, winslash="/")) else getwd()
mami_absolute <- function(path, base=ACTIVE_DIR) {
  if (length(path)!=1L || is.na(path) || !nzchar(trimws(path)))
    stop("Set a nonempty path in the user-settings chunk at the top of this Rmd.")
  path <- path.expand(path)
  if (!grepl("^([A-Za-z]:[/\\\\]|/|\\\\\\\\)", path)) path <- file.path(base,path)
  normalizePath(path, winslash="/", mustWork=FALSE)
}
INPUT_FILE <- mami_absolute(INPUT_FILE)
if (!file.exists(INPUT_FILE) || dir.exists(INPUT_FILE)) {
  stop("Input workbook not found: ",INPUT_FILE,
    ". Edit INPUT_FILE in the first chunk. Use the workbook itself, not its folder.",call.=FALSE)
}
if (!grepl("\\.xlsx$", INPUT_FILE, ignore.case=TRUE))
  stop("INPUT_FILE must be an .xlsx workbook with the six sheets listed in README.md.")
INPUT_FILE <- normalizePath(INPUT_FILE, winslash="/", mustWork=TRUE)
OUTPUT_ROOT <- mami_absolute(OUTPUT_ROOT)
if (.Platform$OS.type=="windows" && nchar(OUTPUT_ROOT,type="bytes")>100L)
  stop("Choose a short OUTPUT_ROOT in the first chunk, for example C:/MAMI_results_simple.")
dir.create(OUTPUT_ROOT, recursive=TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_ROOT)) stop("Cannot create OUTPUT_ROOT: ",OUTPUT_ROOT)
probe <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT,paste0(".write_test_",Sys.getpid()))
can_write <- tryCatch({writeLines("test",probe);unlink(probe);TRUE},error=function(e)FALSE)
if (!can_write) stop("OUTPUT_ROOT is not writable. Choose a local folder you can write to.")
message("Input workbook: ", INPUT_FILE)
message("Results root: ", OUTPUT_ROOT)
# Parse the saved document before executing any lengthy analysis.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE,cache=FALSE)
if (length(ACTIVE_RMD)==1L && nzchar(ACTIVE_RMD) && file.exists(ACTIVE_RMD)) {
  saved_lines <- readLines(ACTIVE_RMD,warn=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8")
  inside_chunk <- FALSE; saved_code <- character(); saved_label <- ""
  for (line in saved_lines) {
    if (!inside_chunk && grepl("^```\\{r([ ,}]|$)",line)) {
      inside_chunk <- TRUE; saved_code <- character(); saved_label <- line
    } else if (inside_chunk && grepl("^```[[:space:]]*$",line)) {
      tryCatch(parse(text=saved_code),error=function(e)
        stop("Syntax error in ",saved_label,": ",conditionMessage(e),call.=FALSE))
      inside_chunk <- FALSE
    } else if (inside_chunk) {
      if (nchar(line,type="bytes")>3000L) stop("R code line exceeds the console-safe length.")
      saved_code <- c(saved_code,line)
    }
  }
  if (inside_chunk) stop("Unclosed R chunk in the saved document.")
}
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT,MODULE_NAME)
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,"tables")
FIG_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,"figures_600dpi")
LOG_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,"logs")
for (d in c(OUTPUT_DIR,TABLE_DIR,FIG_DIR,LOG_DIR)) dir.create(d,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
INPUT_MD5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(INPUT_FILE))
ANALYSIS_SIGNATURE <- paste(PIPELINE_VERSION,INPUT_MD5,MIN_RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE,
 MIN_SAMPLE_PREVALENCE,paste(CLR_ZERO_REPLACEMENTS,collapse=","),PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT,
 MICRO_MIN_N,PERMANOVA_MIN_N,N_PERMUTATIONS,BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES,sep="|")
signature_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_ROOT,"ANALYSIS_SIGNATURE.txt")
if (file.exists(signature_file)) {

} else writeLines(ANALYSIS_SIGNATURE,signature_file)
# Remove the old completion receipt at start; a failed run cannot appear complete.
receipt_file <- file.path(LOG_DIR,"RUN_COMPLETE.csv")
if (file.exists(receipt_file)) unlink(receipt_file)
REQUIRED <- c("readxl","dplyr","tidyr","ggplot2","openxlsx","sandwich","lmtest","vegan","scales","knitr")

 install.packages(missing_packages,repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
missing_packages <- REQUIRED[!vapply(REQUIRED,requireNamespace,logical(1),quietly=TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages)) stop("Install missing packages: ",paste(missing_packages,collapse=", "))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(ggplot2)})
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=12)+theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
 plot.title=element_text(face="bold"),legend.position="bottom",

safe_name <- function(x) {
 x <- iconv(as.character(x),from="",to="ASCII//TRANSLIT",sub="_")
 x <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",x))
 make.unique(gsub("^_+|_+$","",gsub("_+","_",x)),sep="_duplicate_")
}
NUMERIC_IMPORT_AUDIT <- list()
FAMILY_CONFLICT_AUDIT <- list()
strict_numeric <- function(x, label) {
 raw <- trimws(as.character(x))
 missing <- is.na(raw) | toupper(raw) %in% c("","NA","N/A","NAN","NULL")
 # A decimal comma is supported only when it is unambiguously a decimal separator.
 raw[!missing & grepl("^[+-]?[0-9]+,[0-9]+$",raw)] <-
   sub(",",".",raw[!missing & grepl("^[+-]?[0-9]+,[0-9]+$",raw)],fixed=TRUE)
 val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw)); val[missing] <- NA_real_
 bad <- !missing & (!is.finite(val))
 if (any(bad)) stop("Unparseable numeric values in ",label,": ",paste(unique(raw[bad]),collapse=" | "))
 val
}
read_sheet <- function(name) {
 z <- as.data.frame(readxl::read_excel(INPUT_FILE,sheet=name,.name_repair="minimal",
   na=c("","NA","N/A","NaN","NULL")),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 original_names <- names(z); names(z) <- safe_name(original_names)
 if (name %in% c("maternal_foods_48h","maternal_nutrients_48h")) {
  numeric_cols <- setdiff(names(z),c("sample_id","family_code"))
 } else if (name=="clinical_data") {
  numeric_cols <- intersect(c("maternal_age","pregestational_bmi","gestational_age",
    "siblings","infant_ab_before_1_months","infant_ab_before_1_month","infant_ab_before_2_months"),names(z))
 } else if (name=="hm_arsenic") {
  numeric_cols <- intersect(c("asb","as_iii","as_v","dma","mma"),names(z))
 } else numeric_cols <- grep("^g_",names(z),value=TRUE)
 for (v in numeric_cols) {
  before <- paste(class(z[[v]]),collapse="/")
  z[[v]] <- strict_numeric(z[[v]],paste(name,v,sep="/"))
  NUMERIC_IMPORT_AUDIT[[length(NUMERIC_IMPORT_AUDIT)+1L]] <<-
   data.frame(sheet=name,variable=v,class_before=before,class_after="numeric",
    n=nrow(z),n_nonmissing=sum(is.finite(z[[v]])),n_missing=sum(is.na(z[[v]])))
 }
 for (v in names(z)[vapply(z,is.character,logical(1))]) {
  z[[v]] <- trimws(z[[v]])
  z[[v]][toupper(z[[v]]) %in% c("","NA","N/A","NAN","NULL")] <- NA_character_
 }
 if ("sample_id" %in% names(z)) z$sample_id <- as.character(z$sample_id)
 if ("family_code" %in% names(z)) z$family_code <- as.character(z$family_code)
 z
}

std_family <- function(family_code, sample_id = NULL) {
  z <- toupper(trimws(as.character(family_code)))
  z[z %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NULL", "NAN")] <- NA_character_
  z <- sub("\\.0$", "", z)
  is_w <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^W0*[0-9]+$", z)
  z[is_w] <- paste0("W", as.integer(sub("^W", "", z[is_w])))
  is_num <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^0*[0-9]+$", z)
  z[is_num] <- as.character(as.integer(z[is_num]))
  is_suffix <- !is.na(z) & grepl("^0*[0-9]+[A-Z]+$", z)
  z[is_suffix] <- paste0(as.integer(sub("^0*([0-9]+)[A-Z]+$", "\\1", z[is_suffix])),
                         sub("^0*[0-9]+", "", z[is_suffix]))
  if (!is.null(sample_id)) {
    s <- toupper(trimws(as.character(sample_id)))
    # The DB group identifier is NOT a unique mother/infant identifier.
    db <- !is.na(s) & grepl("^SDB[0-9]+[A-Z]+[0-9]{2}H$", s)
    z[db] <- sub("^S(DB[0-9]+[A-Z]+)[0-9]{2}H$", "\\1", s[db])
    m <- !is.na(s) & grepl("^S[0-9]{3}M[0-9]", s)
    z[m] <- as.character(as.integer(sub("^S0*([0-9]+)M.*", "\\1", s[m])))
    # W sample ID is only a fallback when explicit W code is missing.
    w <- !is.na(s) & grepl("^S[0-9]{3}WM", s) & is.na(z)
    if (any(w)) z[w] <- paste0("W", as.integer(sub("^S0*([0-9]+)WM.*", "\\1", s[w])))
  }
  z
}

first_present <- function(x) {
 ix <- which(!is.na(x) & as.character(x)!="")
 if (!length(ix)) return(x[NA_integer_][1])
 x[ix[1]]
}
family_one <- function(z, sheet="unknown", clinical=FALSE) {
 if (any(is.na(z$family_id))) stop("Missing participant keys in ",sheet,"; resolve before linking.")
 cols <- setdiff(names(z),c("sample_id","family_code","family_id"))
 out <- lapply(split(seq_len(nrow(z)),z$family_id),function(ii) {
  dd <- z[ii,,drop=FALSE]; ans <- data.frame(family_id=dd$family_id[1])
  for (v in cols) {
   values <- unique(dd[[v]][!is.na(dd[[v]]) & as.character(dd[[v]])!=""])
   if (length(values)>1L) {
    FAMILY_CONFLICT_AUDIT[[length(FAMILY_CONFLICT_AUDIT)+1L]] <<-
      data.frame(sheet=sheet,family_id=dd$family_id[1],variable=v,
       source_sample_ids=paste(dd$sample_id,collapse=";"),
       conflicting_values=paste(as.character(values),collapse=";"),
       action=if(clinical) "Family-level value set to NA; exact infant sample match can resolve" else "STOP")
    if (!clinical) stop("Conflicting repeated dietary records in ",sheet," for ",dd$family_id[1]," / ",v)
    ans[[v]] <- dd[[v]][NA_integer_][1]
   } else ans[[v]] <- first_present(dd[[v]])
  }
  ans
 })
 bind_rows(out)
}
# Common exports preserve 0-row schemas; note-only sheets are explicitly not results.
save_csv <- function(x,name) {
 if (is.null(x) || !is.data.frame(x)) x <- data.frame()
 if (!ncol(x)) x <- data.frame(status=character())
 utils::write.csv(x,file.path(TABLE_DIR,paste0(name,".csv")),row.names=FALSE,na="")
 invisible(x)
}
save_xlsx <- function(tables,name="ALL_TABLES") {
 wb_out <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
 if (!length(tables)) tables <- list(Status=data.frame(status="No eligible analyses"))
 sn <- make.unique(substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]","_",names(tables)),1,27))
 for (i in seq_along(tables)) {
  dat <- as.data.frame(tables[[i]])
  if (!ncol(dat)) dat <- data.frame(status=character())
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb_out,sn[i])
  openxlsx::writeData(wb_out,sn[i],dat,withFilter=nrow(dat)>0 && ncol(dat)<=50)
  openxlsx::freezePane(wb_out,sn[i],firstRow=TRUE)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb_out,sn[i],openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill="#17324F",fontColour="#FFFFFF",textDecoration="bold"),
    rows=1,cols=seq_len(ncol(dat)),gridExpand=TRUE)
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb_out,sn[i],cols=seq_len(ncol(dat)),widths=18)
 }
 openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb_out,file.path(OUTPUT_DIR,paste0(name,".xlsx")),overwrite=TRUE)
}
FIGURE_EXPORT_ROWS <- list()
save_figure <- function(p,name,width=10.5,height=6.5) {
 # Preserve plot/statistical content; use bounded filenames and explicit file devices.
 stem <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]","_",name)
 if (nchar(stem)>100L) {
  tf <- tempfile(); writeLines(name,tf,useBytes=TRUE)
  suffix <- substr(unname(tools::md5sum(tf)),1,10); unlink(tf)
  stem <- paste0(substr(stem,1,85),"_",suffix)
 }
 pdf_path <- file.path(FIG_DIR,paste0(stem,".pdf"))
 png_path <- file.path(FIG_DIR,paste0(stem,".png"))
 pdf_device <- if(capabilities("cairo"))grDevices::cairo_pdf else grDevices::pdf
 with_seed(seed_key(name),function() ggplot2::ggsave(pdf_path,p,width=width,height=height,
   device=pdf_device,bg="white",limitsize=FALSE))
 png_error <- NA_character_
 # ragg works independently of RStudio's plot pane. Never print(p) here.
 if (file.exists(png_path)) unlink(png_path)
 tryCatch({
  if (requireNamespace("ragg",quietly=TRUE)) {
   with_seed(seed_key(name),function() ggplot2::ggsave(png_path,p,width=width,height=height,
     device=ragg::agg_png,dpi=PLOT_DPI,bg="white",limitsize=FALSE))
  } else if(capabilities("cairo")) {
   with_seed(seed_key(name),function() ggplot2::ggsave(png_path,p,width=width,height=height,
     device=grDevices::png,type="cairo",dpi=PLOT_DPI,bg="white",limitsize=FALSE))
  } else stop("No file-based PNG backend; install ragg. The vector PDF remains available.")
 },error=function(e) { png_error <<- conditionMessage(e)
  if(file.exists(png_path)) unlink(png_path)
  warning("PNG export failed for ",name,": ",png_error,call.=FALSE) })
 FIGURE_EXPORT_ROWS[[length(FIGURE_EXPORT_ROWS)+1L]] <<- data.frame(
  requested_name=name,file_stem=stem,pdf=pdf_path,
  png=if(is.na(png_error))png_path else NA_character_,dpi=PLOT_DPI,
  status=if(is.na(png_error))"complete"else"pdf_only_png_failed",detail=png_error)
 utils::write.csv(do.call(rbind,FIGURE_EXPORT_ROWS),file.path(LOG_DIR,"FIGURE_EXPORT_MANIFEST.csv"),row.names=FALSE)
 invisible(p)
}
record_session <- function() {
 writeLines(c("Source workbook:",INPUT_FILE,"","Workbook MD5:",INPUT_MD5,"",
  "Pipeline version:",PIPELINE_VERSION,"Analysis signature:",ANALYSIS_SIGNATURE,
  "",DIET_REFERENCE_PERIOD,MICROBIOTA_TIMEPOINT,
  "The 48h worksheet suffix is not the dietary reference period.",
  "Microbial RA uses the sum of all supplied genus counts per specimen before subset filtering (not unverified FASTQ read depth).",
  "Within each eligible analysis set: RA >= 0.01 in >=50%; exclude ambiguous names.",
  "Only zero microbial RA values are replaced; positives are not given an additive offset.",
  "CLR uses the retained subcomposition after reclosure; no all-zero or raw-constant taxon discovery.",
  "Arsenic zeros are NOT replaced. LOD/LOQ and assay units remain unresolved.",
  "Energy assumed to be kcal/day as in the supplied pipeline; confirm source nutrient units before publication.",
  "Urine has no creatinine/specific-gravity correction; ratios are not methylation capacity.",
  "Clinical infant-antibiotic coding may include maternal intrapartum treatment: not in default adjustment.",
  "Duration-derived feeding is any breastfeeding, not exclusive; boundary timing unverified.",
  "Genus counts are not genes or strain transmission.","",capture.output(sessionInfo())),
  file.path(LOG_DIR,"session_and_assumptions.txt"))
}
finish_module <- function(status="complete") {
 if (length(FIGURE_EXPORT_ROWS) && any(vapply(FIGURE_EXPORT_ROWS,
   function(x)x$status!="complete",logical(1)))) status <- "complete_with_graphics_warnings"
 save_csv(bind_rows(NUMERIC_IMPORT_AUDIT),"QC_numeric_import")
 save_csv(bind_rows(FAMILY_CONFLICT_AUDIT),"QC_family_conflicts")
 record_session()
 receipt <- data.frame(module=MODULE_NAME,status=status,version=PIPELINE_VERSION,
  input_md5=INPUT_MD5,analysis_signature=ANALYSIS_SIGNATURE,
  script_path=if(length(ACTIVE_RMD)==1L && file.exists(ACTIVE_RMD))
    normalizePath(ACTIVE_RMD,winslash="/")else NA_character_,
  script_md5=if(length(ACTIVE_RMD)==1 && file.exists(ACTIVE_RMD)) unname(tools::md5sum(ACTIVE_RMD)) else NA_character_,
  completed_at=as.character(Sys.time()),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 utils::write.csv(receipt,receipt_file,row.names=FALSE)
 cat("Results directory: ",normalizePath(OUTPUT_DIR,winslash="/"),"\n",sep="")
 knitr::kable(data.frame(output_file=list.files(OUTPUT_DIR,recursive=TRUE)),caption="Outputs and QC files from this run")
}
prep_data <- function() {
 need <- c("clinical_data","genus_mother_1month","genus_infant_1month",
  "maternal_foods_48h","maternal_nutrients_48h","hm_arsenic")
 if (length(setdiff(need,readxl::excel_sheets(INPUT_FILE)))) stop("Required workbook sheets are missing.")
 clinical <- read_sheet("clinical_data"); foods <- read_sheet("maternal_foods_48h")
 nutrients <- read_sheet("maternal_nutrients_48h"); arsenic <- read_sheet("hm_arsenic")
 for (nm in c("clinical","foods","nutrients","arsenic")) {
  dd <- get(nm); dd$family_id <- std_family(dd$family_code,if(nm=="arsenic") NULL else dd$sample_id)
  assign(nm,dd)
 }
 if ("gender" %in% names(clinical)) clinical$infant_sex <- clinical$gender
 clinical1 <- family_one(clinical,"clinical_data",clinical=TRUE)
 food1 <- family_one(foods,"maternal_foods_48h")
 nutrient1 <- family_one(nutrients,"maternal_nutrients_48h")
 if (!"energy" %in% names(nutrient1)) stop("Energy must be supplied in maternal_nutrients_48h.")
 food1$energy <- nutrient1$energy[match(food1$family_id,nutrient1$family_id)]
 food1$energy_provenance <- ifelse(is.finite(food1$energy)&food1$energy>0,"matched_nutrient_energy","missing_nutrient_energy")
 food1$energy[!is.finite(food1$energy)|food1$energy<=0] <- NA_real_
 if(any(is.na(food1$energy))) warning(sum(is.na(food1$energy))," food record(s) lack valid linked energy; no density is imputed.")
 required <- c("asb","as_iii","as_v","dma","mma","sample_site","timepoint_month")
 if(!all(required%in%names(arsenic))) stop("Missing arsenic variables.")
 if(any(as.matrix(arsenic[,c("asb","as_iii","as_v","dma","mma")])<0,na.rm=TRUE)) stop("Negative arsenic measurement.")
 arsenic$month <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^([0-9]+).*","\\1",trimws(arsenic$timepoint_month))))
 arsenic$site <- tolower(trimws(arsenic$sample_site))
 if(any(is.na(arsenic$month)) || any(!arsenic$month%in%c(1L,2L))) stop("Unexpected arsenic month label.")
 if(any(is.na(arsenic$site)) || any(!arsenic$site%in%c("milk","urine"))) stop("Unexpected matrix label.")
 if(any(is.na(arsenic$family_id))) stop("Missing arsenic family key.")
 arsenic$ias <- arsenic$as_iii+arsenic$as_v
 arsenic$methylated_as <- arsenic$mma+arsenic$dma
 arsenic$non_asb_as <- arsenic$ias+arsenic$methylated_as
 arsenic$total_measured_as <- arsenic$asb+arsenic$non_asb_as
 arsenic$speciation_den <- arsenic$non_asb_as
 for (v in c("ias","mma","dma")) arsenic[[paste0("pct_",v)]] <-
  ifelse(is.finite(arsenic$non_asb_as)&arsenic$non_asb_as>0,100*arsenic[[v]]/arsenic$non_asb_as,NA_real_)
 arsenic$pct_asb_total <- ifelse(is.finite(arsenic$total_measured_as)&arsenic$total_measured_as>0,
   100*arsenic$asb/arsenic$total_measured_as,NA_real_)
 arsenic$dma_mma <- ifelse(is.finite(arsenic$mma)&arsenic$mma>0,arsenic$dma/arsenic$mma,NA_real_)
 arsenic$mma_ias <- ifelse(is.finite(arsenic$ias)&arsenic$ias>0,arsenic$mma/arsenic$ias,NA_real_)
 dup <- arsenic %>% count(family_id,site,month,name="n") %>% filter(n>1L)
 if(nrow(dup)) { save_csv(dup,"ERROR_duplicate_arsenic_keys");stop("Duplicate family/matrix/month rows; no averaging performed.") }
 repeated_family <- arsenic %>% count(site,family_id,name="n_records") %>% filter(n_records>1L)
 if(nrow(repeated_family)) {
  save_csv(repeated_family,"ERROR_repeated_families_within_matrix")
  stop("Repeated participants within an arsenic matrix: this version assumes the supplied independent month groups. A longitudinal redesign is required; no silent pooling.")
 }
 milk <- arsenic[arsenic$site=="milk",,drop=FALSE]
 urine <- arsenic[arsenic$site=="urine",,drop=FALSE]
 paired <- inner_join(milk,urine,by=c("family_id","month"),suffix=c("_milk","_urine"))
 attach <- function(d) d %>% left_join(clinical1,by="family_id") %>%
  left_join(food1,by="family_id") %>% left_join(nutrient1,by="family_id",suffix=c("","_nutr"))
 list(arsenic=arsenic,milk=milk,urine=urine,paired=paired,clinical=clinical,clinical1=clinical1,
  foods=food1,nutrients=nutrient1,milkdata=attach(milk),urinedata=attach(urine),
  original_clinical=clinical,original_foods=foods,original_nutrients=nutrients)
}

make_foods <- function(food1, nutrient_lookup=NULL) {
  combos <- list(
    seafood_total=c("hake","salmon","mussel","squid","prawns_shrimp","tuna_in_oil"),
    fish_total=c("hake","salmon","tuna_in_oil"),
    shellfish_mollusc_total=c("mussel","squid","prawns_shrimp"),
    nonrice_grain_total=c("white_bread","whole_grain_bread","breakfast_cereals","whole_grain_cereals","pasta","pizza"),
    cereal_grain_total=c("white_bread","whole_grain_bread","breakfast_cereals","whole_grain_cereals","white_rice","pasta","pizza"),
    milk_total=c("whole_milk","semi_skimmed_milk","skimmed_milk","condensed_milk"),
    dairy_total=c("whole_milk","semi_skimmed_milk","skimmed_milk","condensed_milk","cream","milkshake","whole_yogurt","skimmed_yogurt","petit_suisse","curd","cheese_portions","cured_manchego_cheese","fresh_cheese","flan","ice_cream"),
    wine_total=c("red_wine","white_wine","cava_sparkling_wine"),
    alcohol_total=c("red_wine","white_wine","cava_sparkling_wine","beer","liqueurs","whisky"),
    potato_total=c("potato_chips","homemade_fries","roasted_potatoes")
  )
  dictionary <- list()
  for (nm in names(combos)) {
    cols <- intersect(combos[[nm]], names(food1))
    dictionary[[nm]] <- data.frame(group=nm, listed_components=paste(combos[[nm]],collapse=" + "),
                                   observed_components=paste(cols,collapse=" + "),
                                   missing_components=paste(setdiff(combos[[nm]],cols),collapse=" + "))
    if (length(cols)!=length(combos[[nm]])) {food1[[nm]] <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(food1)); next}
    mat <- as.matrix(food1[,cols,drop=FALSE]); storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"
    v <- rowSums(mat,na.rm=FALSE)
    food1[[nm]] <- v
  }
  # Energy is NOT in maternal_foods_48h. It comes from the corresponding
  # record in maternal_nutrients_48h, matched using the already-audited family_id.
  # Crucially, raw intake and consumer prevalence do not require energy.
  if (!"family_id" %in% names(food1)) stop("make_foods: family_id is required")
  nutrient_energy <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(food1))
  if (!is.null(nutrient_lookup) &&
      all(c("family_id", "energy") %in% names(nutrient_lookup))) {
    if (anyDuplicated(nutrient_lookup$family_id))
      stop("make_foods: nutrient_lookup has repeated family_id; resolve before joining")
    nutrient_energy <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(nutrient_lookup$energy[
      match(food1$family_id, nutrient_lookup$family_id)]))
  }
  if (!"energy" %in% names(food1)) food1$energy <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(food1))
  food1$energy <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(food1$energy))
  if (!"energy_provenance" %in% names(food1))
    food1$energy_provenance <- rep("unavailable", nrow(food1))
  missing_energy <- !is.finite(food1$energy) | food1$energy <= 0
  fill_energy <- missing_energy & is.finite(nutrient_energy) & nutrient_energy > 0
  food1$energy[fill_energy] <- nutrient_energy[fill_energy]
  food1$energy_provenance[fill_energy] <- "matched_nutrient_energy"
  usable_energy <- is.finite(food1$energy) & food1$energy > 0
  food1$energy_provenance[!usable_energy] <- "missing_nutrient_energy"
  # Never energy-normalize previous d2000 columns again if a helper is reused.
  raw <- setdiff(names(food1)[vapply(food1,is.numeric,logical(1))],
                 c("energy", grep("^d2000_", names(food1), value=TRUE)))
  for (nm in raw) {
    y <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(food1))
    valid <- usable_energy & is.finite(food1[[nm]])
    y[valid] <- 2000 * food1[[nm]][valid] / food1$energy[valid]
    food1[[paste0("d2000_",nm)]] <- y
  }
  if (!all(usable_energy))
    warning(sum(!usable_energy), " food participant(s) lack valid energy. ",
            "Consumer prevalence/raw intake are retained; d2000_ density is NA for those participants.")
  list(data=food1, dictionary=dplyr::bind_rows(dictionary), raw_names=raw)
}
make_nutrients <- function(nut) {
  if (!"energy" %in% names(nut)) stop("No energy variable in maternal_nutrients_48h")
  raw <- setdiff(names(nut)[vapply(nut,is.numeric,logical(1))],c("energy",grep("^(eadj_|d2000_)",names(nut),value=TRUE)))
  for (nm in raw) {
    out <- rep(NA_real_,nrow(nut)); ok <- is.finite(nut[[nm]]) & is.finite(nut$energy) & nut$energy>0
    if (sum(ok)>=20 && sd(nut[[nm]][ok])>0 && sd(nut$energy[ok])>0) {
      mod <- lm(nut[[nm]][ok] ~ nut$energy[ok]); out[ok] <- residuals(mod)+mean(nut[[nm]][ok])
    }
    nut[[paste0("eadj_",nm)]] <- out
  }
  nut
}
join_diet <- function(z) {
  fx <- make_foods(z$foods, nutrient_lookup=z$nutrients)
  nx <- make_nutrients(z$nutrients)
  # Replace existing food/nutrient attachments with regenerated, audited columns.
  target <- function(sample_df) sample_df %>% left_join(z$clinical1,by="family_id") %>%
    left_join(fx$data %>% select(-any_of(c("sample_id","family_code"))),by="family_id") %>%
    left_join(nx %>% select(-any_of(c("sample_id","family_code"))),by="family_id",suffix=c("","_nutr"))
  z$milkdata <- target(z$milk)
  z$urinedata <- target(z$urine)
  z$foods <- fx$data; z$nutrients <- nx; z$food_dictionary <- fx$dictionary
  z
}


# Reproducible test-specific random seeds without changing the caller's RNG state.
with_seed <- function(seed,fun) {
 had <- exists(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv,inherits=FALSE)
 if (had) old <- get(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv)
 on.exit({if(had) assign(".Random.seed",old,envir=.GlobalEnv) else if(exists(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv,inherits=FALSE)) rm(".Random.seed",envir=.GlobalEnv)},add=TRUE)
 set.seed(seed); fun()
}
seed_key <- function(x) as.integer((20261027 + sum(utf8ToInt(paste(x,collapse="|"))*seq_along(utf8ToInt(paste(x,collapse="|"))))) %% 2147483000)
bh_full <- function(p) {
 p <- as.numeric(p); good <- is.finite(p)&p>=0&p<=1
 out <- rep(NA_real_,length(p))
 if(any(good)) out[good] <- stats::p.adjust(p[good],method="BH",n=length(p))
 out
}
safe_spear <- function(x,y,min_n=6,B=0L,seed=20261027L) {
 x <- as.numeric(x);y <- as.numeric(y);ok <- is.finite(x)&is.finite(y)
 x<-x[ok];y<-y[ok];n<-length(x)
 res <- data.frame(n=n,rho=NA_real_,rho_ci_low=NA_real_,rho_ci_high=NA_real_,p=NA_real_,
   bootstrap_valid=0L,ci_method=if(B>0)"paired-row percentile bootstrap" else "not requested",status="not estimated")
 if(n<min_n) {res$status<-"insufficient complete cases";return(res)}
 if(length(unique(x))<2 || length(unique(y))<2) {res$status<-"constant variable";return(res)}
 ct<-suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x,y,method="spearman",exact=FALSE))
 res$rho<-unname(ct$estimate);res$p<-ct$p.value;res$status<-"estimated"
 if(B>0L) {
  bs<-with_seed(seed,function() replicate(B,{i<-sample.int(n,n,replace=TRUE);
    if(length(unique(x[i]))<2 || length(unique(y[i]))<2) NA_real_ else suppressWarnings(cor(x[i],y[i],method="spearman"))}))
  bs<-bs[is.finite(bs)];res$bootstrap_valid<-length(bs)
  if(length(bs)>=max(100,ceiling(.8*B))) {
   ci<-quantile(bs,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE);res$rho_ci_low<-ci[1];res$rho_ci_high<-ci[2]
  } else res$ci_method<-"too few valid bootstrap replicates"
 }
 res
}
model_complete <- function(d,exposure,outcome,covariates=character()) {
 req<-unique(c(exposure,outcome,covariates));missing<-setdiff(req,names(d))
 if(length(missing)) return(list(data=d[0,,drop=FALSE],status=paste("missing variables",paste(missing,collapse=";"))))
 good<-complete.cases(d[,req,drop=FALSE])
 for(v in req) if(is.numeric(d[[v]])) good<-good & is.finite(d[[v]])
 list(data=d[good,,drop=FALSE],status="ok")
}
fit_single <- function(d,exposure,outcome,covariates=c("month","pregestational_bmi"),
 min_n=15,transform="log1p",min_per_parameter=4,x_center=NULL,x_scale=NULL,
 standardize=TRUE,allow_repeated=FALSE) {
 b<-data.frame(n=0L,n_families=0L,n_parameters=NA_integer_,required_n=NA_integer_,
 beta=NA_real_,se=NA_real_,ci_low=NA_real_,ci_high=NA_real_,p=NA_real_,
 hc3_se=NA_real_,hc3_ci_low=NA_real_,hc3_ci_high=NA_real_,hc3_p=NA_real_,
 r2=NA_real_,partial_r2=NA_real_,max_cook=NA_real_,n_cook=NA_integer_,
 exposure_center=NA_real_,exposure_scale=NA_real_,formula=NA_character_,
 omitted_constant_covariates="",status="not estimated")
 cc<-model_complete(d,exposure,outcome,covariates);ss<-cc$data
 b$n<-nrow(ss);b$n_families<-if("family_id"%in%names(ss))length(unique(ss$family_id)) else nrow(ss)
 if(cc$status!="ok") {b$status<-cc$status;return(b)}
 if(b$n<3 || !is.numeric(ss[[exposure]]) || !is.numeric(ss[[outcome]])) {b$status<-"insufficient cases or nonnumeric target";return(b)}
 if(!is.finite(sd(ss[[exposure]])) || sd(ss[[exposure]])<=0 || sd(ss[[outcome]])<=0) {b$status<-"constant exposure/outcome";return(b)}
 if(transform=="log1p" && any(ss[[outcome]]<0)) {b$status<-"negative outcome cannot use log1p";return(b)}
 if(!transform%in%c("identity","log1p")) stop("Unknown outcome transform")
 if(b$n_families<b$n && !allow_repeated) {b$status<-"repeated family observations: independent-error model not fitted";return(b)}
 center<-if(!is.null(x_center))x_center else if(standardize)mean(ss[[exposure]]) else 0
 sc<-if(!is.null(x_scale))x_scale else if(standardize)sd(ss[[exposure]]) else 1
 if(!is.finite(sc) || sc<=0) {b$status<-"invalid exposure scaling";return(b)}
 ss$x_z<-(ss[[exposure]]-center)/sc
 ss$y<-if(transform=="log1p")log1p(ss[[outcome]]) else ss[[outcome]]
 terms<-"x_z";omitted<-character()
 for(v in covariates) {
  if(length(unique(ss[[v]]))<2L) {omitted<-c(omitted,v);next}
  nm<-paste0("cov_",v)
  if(is.numeric(ss[[v]])) ss[[nm]]<-as.numeric(scale(ss[[v]])) else ss[[nm]]<-factor(ss[[v]])
  terms<-c(terms,nm)
 }
 ff<-as.formula(paste("y ~",paste(terms,collapse=" + ")))
 mm<-tryCatch(model.matrix(ff,ss),error=function(e)NULL)
 b$formula<-paste(deparse(ff),collapse=" ");b$exposure_center<-center;b$exposure_scale<-sc
 b$omitted_constant_covariates<-paste(omitted,collapse=";")
 if(is.null(mm)) {b$status<-"model matrix failure";return(b)}
 b$n_parameters<-ncol(mm);b$required_n<-as.integer(max(min_n,ceiling(min_per_parameter*ncol(mm))))
 if(nrow(ss)<b$required_n) {b$status<-"insufficient n per parameter";return(b)}
 if(qr(mm)$rank<ncol(mm) || nrow(mm)<=ncol(mm)+1L) {b$status<-"singular/insufficient residual df";return(b)}
 fit<-tryCatch(lm(ff,data=ss),error=function(e)NULL)
 if(is.null(fit)||!"x_z"%in%names(coef(fit))||!is.finite(coef(fit)["x_z"])) {b$status<-"fit failure";return(b)}
 tb<-coef(summary(fit));ci<-confint(fit,"x_z");b$beta<-unname(coef(fit)["x_z"])
 b$se<-unname(tb["x_z","Std. Error"]);b$p<-unname(tb["x_z","Pr(>|t|)"])
 b$ci_low<-ci[1];b$ci_high<-ci[2];b$r2<-summary(fit)$r.squared
 tt<-unname(tb["x_z","t value"]);b$partial_r2<-tt^2/(tt^2+fit$df.residual)
 vc<-tryCatch(sandwich::vcovHC(fit,type="HC3"),error=function(e)NULL)
 if(!is.null(vc) && is.finite(vc["x_z","x_z"]) && vc["x_z","x_z"]>0) {
  b$hc3_se<-sqrt(vc["x_z","x_z"]);crit<-qt(.975,fit$df.residual)
  b$hc3_ci_low<-b$beta-crit*b$hc3_se;b$hc3_ci_high<-b$beta+crit*b$hc3_se
  b$hc3_p<-2*pt(-abs(b$beta/b$hc3_se),df=fit$df.residual)
 }
 ck<-cooks.distance(fit);b$max_cook<-max(ck,na.rm=TRUE);b$n_cook<-sum(ck>4/nrow(ss),na.rm=TRUE)
 b$status<-"estimated";b
}
food_prevalence <- function(d,exposure,outcome,raw_col,covariates=c("month","pregestational_bmi")) {
 cc<-model_complete(d,exposure,outcome,covariates)$data
 raw<-if(raw_col%in%names(cc))as.numeric(cc[[raw_col]]) else rep(NA_real_,nrow(cc))
 ok<-is.finite(raw);pos<-raw[ok&raw>0]
 data.frame(n_with_food=sum(ok),n_consumers=length(pos),
  consumer_pct=if(sum(ok))100*length(pos)/sum(ok)else NA_real_,
  n_nonconsumers=sum(ok)-length(pos),nonzero_median=if(length(pos))median(pos)else NA_real_,
  nonzero_min=if(length(pos))min(pos)else NA_real_,nonzero_max=if(length(pos))max(pos)else NA_real_)
}
run_models <- function(d,exposure_vec,outcome_vec,topic,covars=c("month","pregestational_bmi"),
 min_n=15,transform="log1p",dietary=FALSE) {
 rows<-list();j<-1L
 for(o in outcome_vec) for(x in exposure_vec) {
  if(!all(c(x,o)%in%names(d))) next
  fit<-fit_single(d,x,o,covars,min_n=min_n,transform=transform)
  uf<-fit_single(d,x,o,covariates=character(),min_n=min_n,transform=transform)
  cc<-safe_spear(d[[x]],d[[o]],B=if(grepl("targeted",topic))BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES else 0L,
    seed=seed_key(c(topic,x,o)))
  if(dietary) prev<-food_prevalence(d,x,o,sub("^(d2000_|eadj_)","",x),covars) else
   prev<-data.frame(n_with_food=NA_integer_,n_consumers=NA_integer_,consumer_pct=NA_real_,n_nonconsumers=NA_integer_,
    nonzero_median=NA_real_,nonzero_min=NA_real_,nonzero_max=NA_real_)
  rows[[j]]<-cbind(data.frame(topic=topic,outcome=o,exposure=x,scale=transform,
    exposure_period=DIET_REFERENCE_PERIOD,effect_type=if(transform=="log1p")"beta in log(1+recorded concentration) per 1 SD exposure"else"beta in outcome units per 1 SD exposure"),
    fit,data.frame(unadjusted_n=uf$n,unadjusted_beta=uf$beta,unadjusted_ci_low=uf$ci_low,
    unadjusted_ci_high=uf$ci_high,unadjusted_p=uf$p,unadjusted_status=uf$status,
    spearman_n=cc$n,rho=cc$rho,rho_ci_low=cc$rho_ci_low,rho_ci_high=cc$rho_ci_high,
    spearman_p=cc$p,spearman_bootstrap_valid=cc$bootstrap_valid),prev);j<-j+1L
 }
 if(!length(rows))return(data.frame(topic=character(),outcome=character(),exposure=character(),p=numeric()))
 rr<-bind_rows(rows)
 rr$exposure_support<-ifelse(dietary & is.finite(rr$n_consumers)&(rr$n_consumers<4|rr$n_nonconsumers<4),
  "Sparse consumer/nonconsumer support",if(dietary)"Report measured consumption frequency"else"Continuous nutrient")
 rr<-rr %>% group_by(topic,outcome) %>% mutate(fdr_outcome=bh_full(p),hc3_fdr_outcome=bh_full(hc3_p),
  spearman_fdr_outcome=bh_full(spearman_p),unadjusted_fdr_outcome=bh_full(unadjusted_p),
  n_hypotheses_outcome=n()) %>% ungroup()
 rr$fdr_all_tests<-bh_full(rr$p);rr$hc3_fdr_all_tests<-bh_full(rr$hc3_p)
 rr$spearman_fdr_all_tests<-bh_full(rr$spearman_p);rr$unadjusted_fdr_all_tests<-bh_full(rr$unadjusted_p)
 rr
}
# Model-derived effect CI, nominal p and family q are displayed together.
plot_coefficients <- function(tab,name,title,top=24) {
 if(!nrow(tab)||!all(c("beta","p","ci_low","ci_high")%in%names(tab)))return(invisible(NULL))
 dd<-tab[is.finite(tab$beta)&is.finite(tab$ci_low)&is.finite(tab$ci_high)&is.finite(tab$p),,drop=FALSE]
 if(!nrow(dd))return(invisible(NULL))
 dd<-head(dd[order(dd$p),,drop=FALSE],top)
 qcol<-if("fdr_all_tests"%in%names(dd))"fdr_all_tests"else if("q_all"%in%names(dd))"q_all"else"fdr_outcome"
 qv<-if(qcol%in%names(dd))dd[[qcol]]else rep(NA_real_,nrow(dd))
 dd$label<-paste(sub("^(d2000_|eadj_)","",dd$exposure),dd$outcome,sep=" | ")
 if("matrix"%in%names(dd))dd$label<-paste(dd$matrix,dd$label,sep=" | ")
 dd$label<-factor(dd$label,levels=rev(unique(dd$label)))
 dd$annotation<-sprintf("beta %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]; n=%d; p=%.3g; q=%.3g",dd$beta,dd$ci_low,dd$ci_high,dd$n,dd$p,qv)
 xr<-range(c(dd$ci_low,dd$ci_high,0),finite=TRUE);span<-max(diff(xr),.1)
 p<-ggplot(dd,aes(x=beta,y=label))+geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2)+
  geom_segment(aes(x=ci_low,xend=ci_high,yend=label))+geom_point(size=2.6)+
  geom_text(aes(label=annotation),x=xr[2]+.12*span,hjust=0,size=2.9)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(xr[1]-.08*span,xr[2]+1.9*span),clip="off")+
  labs(title=title,subtitle="Exploratory models; display selection does not change the full FDR family",
   x="Standardized exposure coefficient with conventional 95% CI",y=NULL,
   caption=paste("q:",qcol,". HC3 estimates, complete-case n and consumers are in the full tables.\nDiet represents the third trimester; urinary concentrations are uncorrected for dilution."))
 save_figure(p,name,width=16,height=max(6,.38*nrow(dd)+2.5))
}

# ---------------- Microbiota: eligibility -> raw-RA filter -> zeros -> CLR ----------------
prepare_micro <- function(sheet) {
 z<-read_sheet(sheet);z$family_id<-std_family(z$family_code,z$sample_id)
 taxa<-grep("^g_",names(z),value=TRUE)
 if(length(taxa)<2L)stop("No genus count matrix in ",sheet)
 cm<-as.matrix(z[,taxa,drop=FALSE]);storage.mode(cm)<-"numeric"
 if(any(cm<0,na.rm=TRUE))stop("Negative genus counts in ",sheet)
 if(any(abs(cm-round(cm))>1e-7,na.rm=TRUE))stop("Expected raw integer genus counts, not relative abundances, in ",sheet)
 depth<-rowSums(cm,na.rm=FALSE);bad<-rowSums(!is.finite(cm))
 good<-bad==0L & is.finite(depth)&depth>0 & !is.na(z$family_id)
 qc<-data.frame(family_id=z$family_id,sample_id=z$sample_id,library_size=depth,
  n_missing_counts=bad,included=good,reason=ifelse(bad>0,"missing genus counts: row excluded, NOT zero-imputed",
   ifelse(is.na(z$family_id),"missing participant key",ifelse(!is.finite(depth)|depth<=0,"empty library","eligible"))))
 if(anyDuplicated(z$family_id[good]))stop("Repeated one-month microbiota family keys: resolve specimen identity in ",sheet)
 zz<-z[good,,drop=FALSE];cm<-cm[good,,drop=FALSE];depth<-depth[good]
 ra<-if(length(depth))sweep(cm,1,depth,"/")else cm
 rownames(cm)<-rownames(ra)<-zz$family_id
 meta<-data.frame(family_id=zz$family_id,sample_id=zz$sample_id,library_size=depth,
  observed=rowSums(cm>0),shannon=vegan::diversity(cm,index="shannon"),simpson=vegan::diversity(cm,index="simpson"))
 # Compatibility fields are DESCRIPTIVES only; named taxon tests use the subset filter.
 for(v in c("bifidobacterium","faecalibacterium","blautia"))meta[[v]]<-
  if(paste0("g_",v)%in%colnames(ra))ra[,paste0("g_",v)]else rep(NA_real_,nrow(meta))
 base<-list(meta=meta,counts=cm,relative=ra,quality=qc,raw_n=nrow(z),sheet=sheet)
 sf<-subset_micro(base,meta$family_id,paste0(sheet,"_source_QC"))
 base$taxa_qc<-sf$taxa_audit
 base$taxa_qc$prevalence<-base$taxa_qc$positive_prevalence
 base$filtered_ra<-sf$filtered_ra
 base$clr_matrix<-if(sf$status=="eligible")zero_clr(sf$filtered_ra,PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT)else matrix(numeric(),nrow=nrow(meta),ncol=0)
 base$clr<-data.frame(family_id=meta$family_id,base$clr_matrix,check.names=FALSE)
 base$clr_pseudocount_rel<-PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT
 base
}
zero_clr <- function(ra,delta=PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT) {
 ra<-as.matrix(ra)
 if(ncol(ra)<2L)stop("CLR requires at least two retained genera")
 if(any(!is.finite(ra))||any(ra<0))stop("Invalid RA in CLR")
 if(any(rowSums(ra)<=0))stop("At least one sample has no observed counts in the retained subcomposition")
 if(length(delta)!=1||!is.finite(delta)||delta<=0)stop("Invalid zero-replacement value")
 zz<-ra;zz[zz==0]<-delta
 # Close to unity; CLR is invariant to this row scaling, which is explicit here.
 zz<-sweep(zz,1,rowSums(zz),"/")
 lg<-log(zz);ans<-lg-rowMeans(lg)
 stopifnot(all(is.finite(ans)),max(abs(rowSums(ans)))<1e-8)
 ans
}
subset_micro <- function(micro,ids,analysis_id,threshold=MIN_RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE,prevalence=MIN_SAMPLE_PREVALENCE) {
 if(anyDuplicated(ids))stop("An analysis contains repeated microbiota participant rows: ",analysis_id)
 ix<-match(ids,micro$meta$family_id)
 if(anyNA(ix))stop("Subset contains an unlinked microbiota key: ",analysis_id)
 cm<-micro$counts[ix,,drop=FALSE];ra<-micro$relative[ix,,drop=FALSE];n<-nrow(ra)
 nnz<-if(n)colSums(cm>0)else rep(0L,ncol(cm))
 nab<-if(n)colSums(ra>=threshold)else rep(0L,ncol(cm))
 amb<-grepl("uncultured|unclassified|unknown",colnames(cm),ignore.case=TRUE)
 pass<-n>0 & nab>=ceiling(prevalence*n)&nnz>0&!amb
 vary<-if(n>1)apply(ra,2,function(x)length(unique(x))>1L)else rep(FALSE,ncol(ra))
 audit<-data.frame(analysis_id=rep(analysis_id,ncol(cm)),taxon=colnames(cm),n_eligible=rep(n,ncol(cm)),
  n_raw_positive=as.integer(nnz),positive_prevalence=if(n)nnz/n else rep(NA_real_,ncol(cm)),
  n_at_or_above_threshold=as.integer(nab),prevalence_at_threshold=if(n)nab/n else rep(NA_real_,ncol(cm)),
  mean_relative_abundance=if(n)colMeans(ra)else rep(NA_real_,ncol(cm)),
  ra_threshold=rep(threshold,ncol(cm)),required_n_at_threshold=rep(ceiling(prevalence*n),ncol(cm)),
  selected=pass,raw_ra_varies=vary,
  reason=ifelse(amb,"ambiguous genus label",ifelse(nnz==0,"all zero within eligible subset",
   ifelse(!pass,"fails abundance/prevalence rule",ifelse(!vary,"retained reference only: raw RA constant","retained and variable")))))
 filtered<-ra[,pass,drop=FALSE]
 mass<-if(ncol(filtered))rowSums(filtered)else rep(0,n)
 status<-if(n<MICRO_MIN_N)"fewer than six eligible samples"else if(sum(pass)<2L)"fewer than two retained genera"else
  if(any(mass<=0))"zero retained-library mass in at least one sample: CLR skipped"else"eligible"
 list(ids=ids,meta=micro$meta[ix,,drop=FALSE],counts=cm,relative=ra,filtered_ra=filtered,
  retained_taxa=colnames(filtered),taxa_audit=audit,selected_mass=mass,status=status,n=n)
}
# Exact clinical sample matches take precedence for infant-specific clinical fields;
# uncertain family-level values remain NA rather than taking the first twin record.
attach_micro_clinical <- function(micro,z) {
 cc<-micro$meta %>% left_join(z$clinical1,by="family_id")
 if(!anyDuplicated(z$original_clinical$sample_id)) {
  ix<-match(cc$sample_id,z$original_clinical$sample_id);good<-!is.na(ix)
  for(v in intersect(setdiff(names(z$clinical1),"family_id"),names(z$original_clinical)))
   cc[[v]][good]<-z$original_clinical[[v]][ix[good]]
  cc$clinical_linkage<-ifelse(good,"exact source sample ID","family consensus; conflicts missing")
 } else cc$clinical_linkage<-"family consensus; exact clinical IDs not unique"
 cc
}
# A single geometry and eligibility set is used per outcome and model; delta is varied
# without changing the retained taxa. Genus-wise complete-case selection is forbidden.
micro_analyse <- function(micro,source,outcomes,analysis_id,covariates=character(),
 model=if(length(covariates))"clinical_sensitivity"else"unadjusted",do_permanova=TRUE) {
 rows<-list();pr<-list();aa<-list();man<-list();status_rows<-list();k<-1L;kk<-1L
 if(!"family_id"%in%names(source))stop("Microbial source lacks family_id")
 if(anyDuplicated(source$family_id))stop("Repeated family in microbiota source; stratify sampling month first")
 for(o in intersect(outcomes,names(source))) {
  id<-paste(analysis_id,o,model,sep="__")
  d<-source[source$family_id%in%micro$meta$family_id,,drop=FALSE]
  miss<-setdiff(c(o,covariates),names(d))
  if(length(miss)) {
   status_rows[[length(status_rows)+1L]]<-data.frame(analysis_id=analysis_id,outcome=o,model=model,n_eligible=0L,
    n_genera=0L,status=paste("missing covariates",paste(miss,collapse=";")));next
  }
  eligible<-complete.cases(d[,c(o,covariates),drop=FALSE])
  for(v in c(o,covariates))if(is.numeric(d[[v]]))eligible<-eligible&is.finite(d[[v]])
  if(!is.numeric(d[[o]]))stop("Nonnumeric exposure: ",o)
  man[[length(man)+1L]]<-data.frame(analysis_id=rep(analysis_id,nrow(d)),outcome=rep(o,nrow(d)),model=rep(model,nrow(d)),
   family_id=d$family_id,included=eligible,reason=ifelse(eligible,"eligible before filtering","outcome/ratio denominator or covariate missing"))
  d<-d[eligible,,drop=FALSE]
  sub<-subset_micro(micro,d$family_id,id);aa[[length(aa)+1L]]<-sub$taxa_audit
  status_rows[[length(status_rows)+1L]]<-data.frame(analysis_id=analysis_id,outcome=o,model=model,
   n_eligible=sub$n,n_genera=length(sub$retained_taxa),status=sub$status)
  if(sub$status!="eligible")next
  # Untransformed relative abundance is an explicit compositional sensitivity analysis.
  methods<-c(sprintf("CLR_zero_%g",CLR_ZERO_REPLACEMENTS),"raw_RA_sensitivity")
  for(method in methods) {
   delta<-if(method=="raw_RA_sensitivity")NA_real_ else as.numeric(base::sub("^CLR_zero_","",method))
   response_mat<-if(is.na(delta))sub$filtered_ra else zero_clr(sub$filtered_ra,delta)
   for(tax in colnames(response_mat)) {
    raw<-sub$relative[,tax];nonconstant<-length(unique(raw))>1L
    common<-data.frame(analysis_id=analysis_id,exposure=o,feature=tax,model=model,method=method,
     pseudocount=delta,is_primary=identical(model,"unadjusted")&&is.finite(delta)&&delta==PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT,
     n=sub$n,n_raw_positive=sum(sub$counts[,tax]>0),n_at_threshold=sum(raw>=MIN_RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE),
     positive_pct=100*mean(sub$counts[,tax]>0),threshold_pct=100*mean(raw>=MIN_RELATIVE_ABUNDANCE),
     n_genera_in_CLR=length(sub$retained_taxa),minimum_retained_mass=min(sub$selected_mass),
     covariates=paste(covariates,collapse=";"),effect_type=if(length(covariates))
      if(is.na(delta))"RA change per 1-SD exposure"else"CLR change per 1-SD exposure"else"Spearman rho")
    rr<-data.frame(estimate=NA_real_,ci_low=NA_real_,ci_high=NA_real_,rho=NA_real_,beta=NA_real_,
     p=NA_real_,hc3_p=NA_real_,hc3_ci_low=NA_real_,hc3_ci_high=NA_real_,partial_r2=NA_real_,
     n_parameters=NA_integer_,required_n=NA_integer_,bootstrap_valid=NA_integer_,ci_method="not estimated",status="raw relative abundance constant")
    if(nonconstant) {
     if(!length(covariates)) {
      ss<-safe_spear(d[[o]],response_mat[,tax],B=if(is.finite(delta)&&delta==PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT)BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES else 0L,
         seed=seed_key(c(id,tax)))
      rr$estimate<-rr$rho<-ss$rho;rr$p<-ss$p;rr$ci_low<-ss$rho_ci_low;rr$ci_high<-ss$rho_ci_high;rr$status<-ss$status;rr$bootstrap_valid<-ss$bootstrap_valid;rr$ci_method<-ss$ci_method
     } else {
      dd<-d;dd$microbial_response<-response_mat[,tax]
      ff<-fit_single(dd,o,"microbial_response",covariates=covariates,min_n=15,transform="identity")
      rr$estimate<-rr$beta<-ff$beta;rr$ci_low<-ff$ci_low;rr$ci_high<-ff$ci_high
      rr$p<-ff$p;rr$hc3_p<-ff$hc3_p;rr$hc3_ci_low<-ff$hc3_ci_low;rr$hc3_ci_high<-ff$hc3_ci_high
      rr$partial_r2<-ff$partial_r2;rr$n_parameters<-ff$n_parameters;rr$required_n<-ff$required_n;rr$status<-ff$status;rr$ci_method<-"Conventional t interval; separate HC3 t interval"
     }
    }
    rows[[k]]<-cbind(common,rr);k<-k+1L
   }
   if(do_permanova && is.finite(delta)) {
    pv<-micro_permanova(response_mat,d,o,covariates)
    pr[[kk]]<-cbind(data.frame(analysis_id=analysis_id,exposure=o,model=model,method=method,pseudocount=delta),pv);kk<-kk+1L
   }
  }
 }
 list(taxa=bind_rows(rows),permanova=bind_rows(pr),filtering=bind_rows(aa),eligibility=bind_rows(man),status=bind_rows(status_rows))
}
micro_permanova <- function(cm,d,exposure,covariates=character()) {
 n<-nrow(cm);b<-data.frame(n=n,n_genera=ncol(cm),r2=NA_real_,pseudo_f=NA_real_,p=NA_real_,
  n_parameters=NA_integer_,n_permutations=N_PERMUTATIONS,status="not estimated")
 if(n<PERMANOVA_MIN_N){b$status<-"n below PERMANOVA minimum";return(b)}
 if(length(unique(d[[exposure]]))<2){b$status<-"constant exposure";return(b)}
 dat<-data.frame(x_z=as.numeric(scale(d[[exposure]])));terms<-"x_z"
 for(v in covariates)if(length(unique(d[[v]]))>1){
  nm<-paste0("cov_",v);dat[[nm]]<-if(is.numeric(d[[v]]))as.numeric(scale(d[[v]]))else factor(d[[v]]);terms<-c(terms,nm)
 }
 mm<-model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~",paste(terms,collapse="+"))),dat)
 b$n_parameters<-ncol(mm)
 if(n<max(PERMANOVA_MIN_N,4L*ncol(mm))||qr(mm)$rank<ncol(mm)){
  b$status<-"insufficient sample per parameter or singular design";return(b)
 }
 dst<-dist(cm);ff<-as.formula(paste("dst ~",paste(terms,collapse=" + ")))
 pv<-tryCatch(with_seed(seed_key(c(exposure,paste(d$family_id,collapse="|"))),function()
  vegan::adonis2(ff,data=dat,permutations=N_PERMUTATIONS,by="margin")),error=function(e)e)
 if(inherits(pv,"error")){b$status<-paste("PERMANOVA error",conditionMessage(pv));return(b)}
 if(!"x_z"%in%rownames(pv)){b$status<-"exposure term not found";return(b)}
 b$r2<-pv["x_z","R2"];b$pseudo_f<-pv["x_z","F"];b$p<-pv["x_z","Pr(>F)"];b$status<-"estimated";b
}
combine_micro <- function(parts) {
 getpart<-function(nm)bind_rows(lapply(parts,function(x)x[[nm]]))
 ans<-list(taxa=getpart("taxa"),permanova=getpart("permanova"),filtering=getpart("filtering"),
  eligibility=getpart("eligibility"),status=getpart("status"))
 if(nrow(ans$taxa)) {
  ans$taxa<-ans$taxa %>% group_by(model,method,analysis_id,exposure) %>%
   mutate(q_family=bh_full(p),hc3_q_family=bh_full(hc3_p),n_hypotheses_family=n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
   group_by(model,method) %>% mutate(q_module=bh_full(p),hc3_q_module=bh_full(hc3_p),n_hypotheses_module=n()) %>% ungroup()
 }
 if(nrow(ans$permanova))ans$permanova<-ans$permanova %>% group_by(model,method) %>%
  mutate(q_module=bh_full(p),n_hypotheses_module=n()) %>% ungroup()
 ans
}
sensitivity_micro <- function(tab) {
 if(!nrow(tab))return(data.frame())
 dd<-tab[tab$model=="unadjusted"&grepl("^CLR_zero_",tab$method),,drop=FALSE]
 dd %>% group_by(analysis_id,exposure,feature) %>% summarise(n=n[1],
  n_pseudocounts=sum(is.finite(rho)),rho_min=if(any(is.finite(rho)))min(rho,na.rm=TRUE)else NA_real_,
  rho_max=if(any(is.finite(rho)))max(rho,na.rm=TRUE)else NA_real_,
  sign_consistent=if(all(is.finite(rho)))length(unique(sign(rho)))==1L else NA,
  all_q_module_below_005=if(all(is.finite(q_module)))all(q_module<.05)else NA,
  .groups="drop")
}
run_alpha <- function(micro,source,outcomes,analysis_id) {
 d<-source %>% inner_join(micro$meta %>% select(family_id,observed,shannon,simpson),by="family_id")
 rows<-list();i<-1L
 for(o in intersect(outcomes,names(d)))for(v in c("observed","shannon","simpson")) {
  s<-safe_spear(d[[o]],d[[v]],B=BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES,seed=seed_key(c(analysis_id,o,v)))
  rows[[i]]<-cbind(data.frame(analysis_id=analysis_id,exposure=o,feature=v,
   effect_type="Spearman rho; diversity from unfiltered non-pseudocounted genus counts"),s);i<-i+1L
 }
 bind_rows(rows)
}
alpha_fdr <- function(tab) {
 if(!nrow(tab))return(tab)
 tab %>% group_by(analysis_id) %>% mutate(q_family=bh_full(p)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(q_module=bh_full(p))
}
export_micro <- function(ans,alpha=data.frame(),prefix="microbiota") {
 sens<-sensitivity_micro(ans$taxa)
 save_csv(ans$taxa,paste0(prefix,"_ALL_taxon_effects_p_q"))
 save_csv(ans$permanova,paste0(prefix,"_PERMANOVA_effects_p_q"))
 save_csv(ans$filtering,paste0(prefix,"_ALL_subset_filtering"))
 save_csv(ans$eligibility,paste0(prefix,"_eligible_samples"))
 save_csv(ans$status,paste0(prefix,"_analysis_status"))
 save_csv(alpha,paste0(prefix,"_alpha_diversity_effects_p_q"))
 save_csv(sens,paste0(prefix,"_pseudocount_sensitivity"))
 save_xlsx(list(Taxon_effects=ans$taxa,PERMANOVA=ans$permanova,Subset_filtering=ans$filtering,
  Eligible_samples=ans$eligibility,Analysis_status=ans$status,Alpha=alpha,Pseudocount_sensitivity=sens))
}
plot_micro <- function(tab,name,title,top=24L) {
 if(!nrow(tab))return(invisible(NULL))
 dd<-tab[tab$is_primary & is.finite(tab$rho) & is.finite(tab$p),,drop=FALSE]
 if(!nrow(dd))return(invisible(NULL))
 dd<-head(dd[order(dd$p),,drop=FALSE],top)
 dd$label<-paste(dd$analysis_id,dd$exposure,sub("^g_","",dd$feature),sep=" | ")
 dd$label<-factor(dd$label,levels=rev(unique(dd$label)))
 dd$annotation<-sprintf("rho=%.2f; n=%d; p=%.3g; q=%.3g; detected %d/%d",
  dd$rho,dd$n,dd$p,dd$q_module,dd$n_raw_positive,dd$n)
 p<-ggplot(dd,aes(rho,label))+geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2)+
  geom_segment(aes(x=ci_low,xend=ci_high,yend=label),na.rm=TRUE)+geom_point(size=2.6)+
  geom_text(aes(label=annotation),x=1.08,hjust=0,size=2.8)+
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1,3.5),clip="off")+
  labs(title=title,subtitle="Eligible-subset filter before zero replacement; primary replacement 1e-6",
   x="Spearman rho with percentile-bootstrap 95% CI",y=NULL,
   caption="q is BH across all eligible genus/outcome/timepoint tests within this module's primary method.\nTop rows are for display only; full results, exclusions and sensitivity analyses are exported. No measured gene activity.")
 save_figure(p,name,width=18,height=max(6,.4*nrow(dd)+2.5))
}
# Compatibility helper for NON-genus correlations only. Never pass a globally CLR-transformed matrix.
run_micro_correlations <- function(data,outcomes,features,topic,min_n=6) {
 rows<-list();i<-1L
 for(o in intersect(outcomes,names(data)))for(f in intersect(features,names(data))) {
  rr<-safe_spear(data[[f]],data[[o]],min_n=min_n)
  rows[[i]]<-cbind(data.frame(topic=topic,exposure=o,feature=f),rr);i<-i+1L
 }
 d<-bind_rows(rows)
 if(nrow(d))d<-d %>% group_by(topic,exposure) %>% mutate(fdr_per_exposure=bh_full(p)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(fdr_all_tests=bh_full(p))
 d
}

# Endpoint data with clinical fields matched to the one-month specimen; no duplicate alpha columns.
micro_source <- function(micro,endpoint,z) {
 cc<-attach_micro_clinical(micro,z)
 keep<-unique(c("family_id",intersect(setdiff(names(z$clinical1),"family_id"),names(cc)),"clinical_linkage"))
 ep<-endpoint[,setdiff(names(endpoint),setdiff(keep,"family_id")),drop=FALSE]
 ep %>% left_join(cc[,keep,drop=FALSE],by="family_id")
}
# Resampling is performed only for a model that passes the ORIGINAL design gate.
# Freeze the original exposure centre/SD: LOFO estimates are on the same effect scale.
resample_model <- function(d,x,y,covariates=c("month","pregestational_bmi"),transform="log1p",
 B=BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES,standardize=TRUE) {
 cc<-model_complete(d,x,y,covariates)$data
 fit<-fit_single(cc,x,y,covariates,transform=transform,standardize=standardize)
 row<-cbind(data.frame(exposure=x,outcome=y),fit)
 row$bootstrap_ci_low<-row$bootstrap_ci_high<-NA_real_;row$bootstrap_valid<-0L
 row$lofo_min_beta<-row$lofo_max_beta<-NA_real_;row$lofo_sign_consistent<-NA
 detail<-list()
 if(fit$status!="estimated")return(list(summary=row,lofo=data.frame()))
 center<-fit$exposure_center;scale_x<-fit$exposure_scale
 for(id in unique(cc$family_id)) {
  dd<-cc[cc$family_id!=id,,drop=FALSE]
  f<-fit_single(dd,x,y,covariates,transform=transform,x_center=center,x_scale=scale_x,
    min_n=5,min_per_parameter=0)
  detail[[length(detail)+1L]]<-cbind(data.frame(exposure=x,outcome=y,excluded_family=id),f)
 }
 loo<-bind_rows(detail);valid<-loo$beta[is.finite(loo$beta)]
 if(length(valid)) {row$lofo_min_beta<-min(valid);row$lofo_max_beta<-max(valid)
  row$lofo_sign_consistent<-all(sign(valid)==sign(fit$beta))}
 # Duplicate resampled rows are intentional bootstrap weights, not extra subjects.
 bs<-with_seed(seed_key(c(MODULE_NAME,x,y,"bootstrap")),function()replicate(B,{
  ii<-sample.int(nrow(cc),nrow(cc),replace=TRUE)
  fit_single(cc[ii,,drop=FALSE],x,y,covariates,transform=transform,x_center=center,x_scale=scale_x,
   min_n=5,min_per_parameter=0,allow_repeated=TRUE)$beta
 }))
 bs<-bs[is.finite(bs)];row$bootstrap_valid<-length(bs)
 if(length(bs)>=max(100L,ceiling(.8*B))) {
  ci<-quantile(bs,c(.025,.975),names=FALSE);row$bootstrap_ci_low<-ci[1];row$bootstrap_ci_high<-ci[2]
 }
 list(summary=row,lofo=loo)
}
# Independent-group effect: probability group B exceeds group A minus reverse probability.
# Also report a location difference; these are not within-subject changes.
group_effect <- function(a,b,B=BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES,min_group=4,seed=20261027L) {
 a<-a[is.finite(a)];b<-b[is.finite(b)]
 out<-data.frame(n_A=length(a),n_B=length(b),median_A=if(length(a))median(a)else NA_real_,
  median_B=if(length(b))median(b)else NA_real_,median_difference_B_minus_A=NA_real_,
  median_difference_ci_low=NA_real_,median_difference_ci_high=NA_real_,
  rank_biserial=NA_real_,rank_biserial_ci_low=NA_real_,rank_biserial_ci_high=NA_real_,
  p=NA_real_,status="insufficient group size")
 if(length(a)<min_group||length(b)<min_group)return(out)
 delta<-function(x,y)mean(sign(outer(y,x,"-")))
 out$median_difference_B_minus_A<-median(b)-median(a);out$rank_biserial<-delta(a,b)
 if(length(unique(c(a,b)))<2){out$status<-"constant outcome";return(out)}
 out$p<-suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a,b,exact=FALSE)$p.value);out$status<-"estimated"
 if(B>0){bs<-with_seed(seed,function()replicate(B,{
  aa<-sample(a,length(a),replace=TRUE);bb<-sample(b,length(b),replace=TRUE)
  c(median(bb)-median(aa),delta(aa,bb))}))
  ci1<-quantile(bs[1,],c(.025,.975),names=FALSE);ci2<-quantile(bs[2,],c(.025,.975),names=FALSE)
  out$median_difference_ci_low<-ci1[1];out$median_difference_ci_high<-ci1[2]
  out$rank_biserial_ci_low<-ci2[1];out$rank_biserial_ci_high<-ci2[2]
 }
 out
}

# Complete explicit column mapping (legacy module09 labels do not match source prefixes).
make_triad_evidence <- function(d) {
 if(!is.data.frame(d)||!nrow(d))return(data.frame(path=character(),link=character(),rho=numeric(),p=numeric(),q=numeric(),n=integer()))
 prefixes<-c(diet_milk="diet_to_milk",milk_urine="milk_to_urine",diet_urine="diet_to_urine")
 bind_rows(lapply(names(prefixes),function(edge){pr<-prefixes[[edge]]
  cols<-c(paste0(pr,"_rho"),paste0(pr,"_p"),paste0("q_",edge))
  if(!all(cols%in%names(d)))stop("Missing triad columns: ",paste(setdiff(cols,names(d)),collapse=", "))
  data.frame(path=paste(d$diet,d$arsenic_species,sep=" | "),link=rep(edge,nrow(d)),
   rho=d[[cols[1]]],p=d[[cols[2]]],q=d[[cols[3]]],n=d$n_same_triple)
 }))
}

plot_alpha_effects <- function(alpha,name,title,top=24L) {
 if(!nrow(alpha))return(invisible(NULL))
 dd<-alpha[is.finite(alpha$rho)&is.finite(alpha$p),,drop=FALSE]
 if(!nrow(dd))return(invisible(NULL))
 dd<-head(dd[order(dd$p),,drop=FALSE],top)
 dd$label<-paste(dd$analysis_id,dd$exposure,dd$feature,sep=" | ")
 dd$label<-factor(dd$label,levels=rev(unique(dd$label)))
 dd$note<-sprintf("rho=%.2f; n=%d; p=%.3g; q=%.3g",dd$rho,dd$n,dd$p,dd$q_module)
 pp<-ggplot(dd,aes(rho,label))+geom_vline(xintercept=0,linetype=2)+
  geom_segment(aes(x=rho_ci_low,xend=rho_ci_high,yend=label),na.rm=TRUE)+geom_point()+
  geom_text(aes(label=note),x=1.05,hjust=0,size=2.8)+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1,3),clip="off")+
  labs(title=title,x="Spearman rho with percentile-bootstrap 95% CI",y=NULL,
   caption="Diversity uses unfiltered, non-pseudocounted genus counts; observed is genus richness, not ASV richness.\nq covers all diversity-outcome/linkage tests in this module; displayed rows do not define the FDR family.")
 save_figure(pp,name,width=17,height=max(6,.4*nrow(dd)+2.5))
}
plot_eligible_ordination <- function(micro,source,exposure,analysis_id,ans,name,title) {
 d<-source[source$family_id%in%micro$meta$family_id & is.finite(source[[exposure]]),,drop=FALSE]
 ss<-subset_micro(micro,d$family_id,paste0(analysis_id,"_ordination"))
 if(ss$status!="eligible"||length(ss$retained_taxa)<3L)return(invisible(NULL))
 cm<-zero_clr(ss$filtered_ra,PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT)
 ord<-tryCatch(cmdscale(dist(cm),k=2,eig=TRUE),error=function(e)NULL)
 if(is.null(ord)||ncol(ord$points)<2||sum(ord$eig>1e-10)<2)return(invisible(NULL))
 pct<-100*pmax(ord$eig[1:2],0)/sum(pmax(ord$eig,0))
 pd<-data.frame(PCoA1=ord$points[,1],PCoA2=ord$points[,2],exposure_value=d[[exposure]])
 tt<-ans$permanova
 tt<-tt[tt$analysis_id==analysis_id & tt$exposure==exposure & tt$model=="unadjusted" & tt$pseudocount==PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT,,drop=FALSE]
 note<-if(nrow(tt))sprintf("n=%d; genera=%d; PERMANOVA R2=%.3f; p=%.3g; q=%.3g",nrow(d),ncol(cm),tt$r2[1],tt$p[1],tt$q_module[1])else paste("n=",nrow(d),"; no estimable community test")
 pp<-ggplot(pd,aes(PCoA1,PCoA2,color=exposure_value))+geom_point(size=3)+
  labs(title=title,subtitle=note,x=sprintf("Aitchison PCoA1 (%.1f%%)",pct[1]),y=sprintf("Aitchison PCoA2 (%.1f%%)",pct[2]),color=exposure,
   caption="This is microbial-composition ordination, NOT dietary PCA. Endpoint-specific filtering and primary zero replacement.\nColours are observed arsenic values in unverified source units; no causal interpretation.")
 save_figure(pp,name,width=11,height=7)
}

z<-prep_data();mat<-prepare_micro("genus_mother_1month");inf<-prepare_micro("genus_infant_1month")
ids<-intersect(mat$meta$family_id,inf$meta$family_id)
# A SINGLE shared reference composition is required for between-mother/infant distances.
# Here the 1% / 50% rule applies across the 2*n paired specimens. It is not relaxed
# to a union of taxa selected independently in mothers and infants.
paired_geometry<-function(fids,id) {
 taxa<-intersect(colnames(mat$counts),colnames(inf$counts))
 mi<-match(fids,mat$meta$family_id);ii<-match(fids,inf$meta$family_id)
 cm<-rbind(mat$counts[mi,taxa,drop=FALSE],inf$counts[ii,taxa,drop=FALSE])
 # Relative abundances retain each specimen's ORIGINAL full-library denominator.
 ra<-rbind(mat$relative[mi,taxa,drop=FALSE],inf$relative[ii,taxa,drop=FALSE])
 keys<-c(paste0("M_",fids),paste0("I_",fids));rownames(cm)<-rownames(ra)<-keys
 obj<-list(meta=data.frame(family_id=keys),counts=cm,relative=ra)
 subset_micro(obj,keys,id)
}
ss<-paired_geometry(ids,"paired_maternal_infant_all_families")
save_csv(ss$taxa_audit,"paired_SHARED_composition_filter")
flow<-data.frame(n_maternal=nrow(mat$meta),n_infant=nrow(inf$meta),n_pairs=length(ids),
 n_shared_retained_genera=length(ss$retained_taxa),n_zero_retained_mass=sum(ss$selected_mass<=0),status=ss$status)
manifest<-data.frame(family_id=ids,maternal_sample=mat$meta$sample_id[match(ids,mat$meta$family_id)],
 infant_sample=inf$meta$sample_id[match(ids,inf$meta$family_id)])
rows<-list();null_rows<-list();distances<-list()
if(ss$status=="eligible")for(delta in CLR_ZERO_REPLACEMENTS) {
 cm<-zero_clr(ss$filtered_ra,delta);n<-length(ids)
 M<-cm[seq_len(n),,drop=FALSE];I<-cm[n+seq_len(n),,drop=FALSE]
 obs_each<-sqrt(rowSums((M-I)^2));obs<-mean(obs_each)
 null<-with_seed(seed_key("paired_similarity"),function()replicate(N_PERMUTATIONS,
  mean(sqrt(rowSums((M-I[sample.int(n),,drop=FALSE])^2)))))
 ci<-with_seed(seed_key("paired_mean_CI"),function()quantile(replicate(BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES,
  mean(sample(obs_each,n,replace=TRUE))),c(.025,.975),names=FALSE))
 rows[[length(rows)+1L]]<-data.frame(pseudocount=delta,n_pairs=n,n_genera=ncol(cm),
  observed_mean_Aitchison=obs,mean_ci_low=ci[1],mean_ci_high=ci[2],
  permutation_null_mean=mean(null),observed_minus_null_mean=obs-mean(null),
  standardized_null_effect=if(sd(null)>0)(obs-mean(null))/sd(null)else NA_real_,
  p=(1+sum(null<=obs))/(1+length(null)),n_permutations=length(null),
  ci_definition="Paired-family bootstrap CI for observed mean distance; fixed filtered geometry")
 null_rows[[length(null_rows)+1L]]<-data.frame(pseudocount=delta,permuted_mean=null)
 distances[[length(distances)+1L]]<-data.frame(family_id=ids,pseudocount=delta,Aitchison_distance=obs_each)
 if(delta==PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT){
  pp<-ggplot(data.frame(permuted_mean=null),aes(permuted_mean))+geom_histogram(bins=35)+
   geom_vline(xintercept=obs,linetype=2)+
   labs(title="Mother–infant one-month genus-composition similarity",x="Mean Aitchison distance",y="Permutations",
    subtitle=sprintf("Observed %.3f [%.3f, %.3f]; observed-null %.3f; n=%d; permutation p=%.4g",obs,ci[1],ci[2],obs-mean(null),n,(1+sum(null<=obs))/(1+length(null))),
    caption="All distances use the same strict shared taxon filter. Similarity is not strain transmission.")
  save_figure(pp,"F08_paired_similarity_permutation",width=12,height=7)
 }
}
results<-bind_rows(rows);if(nrow(results))results$q_sensitivity_family<-bh_full(results$p)
# Endpoint-specific paired distance correlations would require refiltering again.
# Report their feasibility separately; never reuse a globally transformed distance.
linked_rows<-list();linked_audits<-list()
for(mo in 1:2) for(sp in c("asb","ias","dma")) {
 d<-z$milk[z$milk$month==mo & z$milk$family_id%in%ids & is.finite(z$milk[[sp]]),,drop=FALSE]
 sub<-paired_geometry(d$family_id,paste0("paired_distance_milk",mo,"_",sp));linked_audits[[length(linked_audits)+1L]]<-sub$taxa_audit
 if(sub$status=="eligible")for(delta in CLR_ZERO_REPLACEMENTS) {
  cm<-zero_clr(sub$filtered_ra,delta);n<-nrow(d)
  dst<-sqrt(rowSums((cm[seq_len(n),,drop=FALSE]-cm[n+seq_len(n),,drop=FALSE])^2))
  rr<-safe_spear(d[[sp]],dst,B=if(delta==PRIMARY_ZERO_REPLACEMENT)BOOTSTRAP_REPLICATES else 0L)
  linked_rows[[length(linked_rows)+1L]]<-cbind(data.frame(month=mo,species=sp,pseudocount=delta,n_genera=ncol(cm)),rr)
 }
}
linked<-bind_rows(linked_rows)
if(nrow(linked))linked<-linked%>%group_by(pseudocount)%>%mutate(q_module=bh_full(p))%>%ungroup()
save_csv(flow,"paired_microbiota_flow_and_feasibility");save_csv(manifest,"paired_ID_manifest")
save_csv(results,"paired_permutation_effects");save_csv(bind_rows(distances),"paired_distances_if_estimable")
save_csv(linked,"subset_refiltered_paired_distance_milk_associations")
save_csv(bind_rows(linked_audits),"milk_linked_paired_filter_audit")
save_xlsx(list(Flow=flow,Pairs=manifest,Filter=ss$taxa_audit,Permutation_effects=results,
 Distances=bind_rows(distances),Linked_effects=linked,Linked_filters=bind_rows(linked_audits)))
knitr::kable(flow,caption="Strict shared composition feasibility; no automatic relaxation of the requested filter")

```

# Interpretation boundaries

Maternal dietary variables refer to the **third trimester of gestation**, irrespective of the legacy `_48h` worksheet names. Both faecal microbiota tables refer to **one month postpartum**. Human-milk and infant-urine arsenic retain the workbook’s nominal 1- and 2-month labels; exact days are unavailable. These observational associations do not establish mediation, microbial arsenic metabolism or strain transmission.

The microbiota rule is **relative abundance at least 0.01 (1%) in at least 50% of the eligible specimens**. Eligibility, including nonzero arsenic-ratio denominators and covariate completeness, precedes filtering. Only microbial zeros are replaced (primary 1e-6; sensitivities 1e-7 and 1e-5), followed by reclosure and CLR. Chemical arsenic zeros are never pseudocounted. Each CLR result refers to its retained subcomposition; no all-zero genus may become a discovery through CLR centring. All excluded taxa, tested families and sample counts are exported.

Urinary concentrations are not dilution-corrected. Ratio denominators can be small and analytical LOD/LOQ and concentration units are unverified. Genus-level 16S does not measure genes. Reference-genome evidence is not participant-specific gene carriage. Duration-derived feeding describes any breastfeeding, not exclusive breastfeeding. Antibiotic recipient/timing needs confirmation and is not in default adjustment. No automatic deletion of influential samples or p-value-driven covariate selection is performed. Dietary PCA is not part of this source release. See README.md for the retained methods and interpretation.

**Validation boundary:** setup includes a saved-code syntax preflight using your local R; there is no companion test script. Packaging and code-preservation checks were performed, but these revisions have not been fully knitted in the authoring environment. Inspect run receipts, model statuses and diagnostics after execution; skipped models are not null results.
